d:
I have been a big fan of Nagi ichi for a long time, and was curious why there hadn't been any works out his out recently.

Thinking that Nagi Ichi had simply put his works behind a paywall, I spent an hour working out how to get a fantia subscription. After finally paying the $4/mo using a mixture of bitcash and Toracoin, I managed to get subscriber access.

Only to realize he wasn't even posting full images of his works.

I am disappointed in the result, and am curious if anyone has any advice on this matter.

Enjoy (try to lol)
